notes: This contract records a narrow official C++ API check for the 2025 region-template commit rule. The Lab candidate is truncated and assigns the rule to §9.1.3.2; RL-359 records the source-backed correction to §9.1.3.1 and the omitted pending-effects continuation. The case asserts that a partial commit throws InvalidRegion, the earlier range remains queryable as pending, the incomplete template is not usable for regional registration, and completing all dimension bounds followed by commit makes it usable. It does not claim complete DDM region or conformance coverage.
